boarding_houses: School House (plus Aspiring Lodge for international students)
contact_title: Director of Boarding (started 19 April 2026; OBHS old boy and former boarder)
gap_notes: No published gap tutor programme found. Staff list shows a Senior House Master but no named tutors. Dunedin is a university city, so resident tutors are often Otago University students. Worth asking.
rugby_notes: Traditional southern rugby school. From 2026 plays in the separate South Island Boys' Schools First XV competition (with King's High and Southland Boys') rather than the main Southern Schools qualifiers. Long list of All Black old boys.
scenery_notes: Dunedin: Otago Peninsula wildlife, surf beaches (St Clair), close to Central Otago skiing about 3 hrs away.
notes: The published email is a role address listed directly under Lance Taylor's name. The old URLs obhs.school.nz/boarding/... now return 404, so use /our-approach/boarding/.

alt_email: richie.buchanan@mcglashan.school.nz (Asst Manager - Senior Hall); george.konia@mcglashan.school.nz (Asst Manager - Junior Hall); rosemary.stevenson@mcglashan.school.nz (Asst Manager - Wellbeing); admin@mcglashan.school.nz
gap_notes: The boarding page says the house is staffed by a Director, assistant managers, a matron and 'a number of housemasters'. That kind of house is typical for gap/resident tutors. No explicit gap programme is published.
rugby_notes: Division One of the 2026 Southern Schools Rugby Championship: beat OBHS 8-7 and St Kevin's 45-22, lost 66-7 to Southland Boys' in the semifinal. A solid Division One side.
scenery_notes: Leafy Dunedin hill suburb. Otago Peninsula and beaches nearby. The school also runs an outdoor base at Te Anau (Fiordland).
notes: Also listed on the staff page https://www.mcglashan.school.nz/our-people/staff as 'Director of Boarding | Community, Engagement and Advancement'. International Baccalaureate school, which suits an Economics/Philosophy/Maths tutor.

boarders_approx: unknown (4 dormitories; Year 10-13 boarders have single rooms). Historically about 80-100
gap_notes: No published gap programme. The site mentions a Residential Manager and a diverse boarding team. Older sources name earlier directors (Scott Mayhew, Andrew Kaufana), so use Ryan Wilson.
rugby_notes: A proud rugby tradition (one of NZ's oldest schools). In the 2026 SSRC qualifiers, Pool A. Finished 6th in 2025 after losing the Division Two final to the Southland Boys' 2nd XV.
scenery_notes: Coastal Oamaru: Victorian precinct, blue penguin colony, Waitaki Valley. About 2.5 hrs to the Mackenzie Country, Aoraki/Mt Cook and ski fields.
notes: The school has a school farm and shooting range. The Don House page is at /opportunities/boarding.

boarding_houses: Redcastle Boarding (boys and girls, Years 9-13, private rooms)
alt_email: college@stkevins.school.nz (office); principal@stkevins.school.nz; cagardner@stkevins.school.nz (Dr Catherine Gardner, International Director)
gap_notes: No published gap programme found. The hostel is owned by the St Kevin's College Hostel Trust. Its centenary is coming up.
rugby_notes: Traditional rugby school. 2026 SSRC Pool A: beat Waitaki Boys' 29-28 and lost to John McGlashan 45-22. Finished 7th in 2025. Offers Cambridge curriculum.
scenery_notes: Coastal Oamaru, same as Waitaki Boys'. Access to the Waitaki lakes, Aoraki/Mt Cook and Ohau skiing.
notes: The staff page (2026 photos) lists 'Mr J Fowler, Director of Boarding' with a mailto link to jfowler@stkevins.school.nz on his card. The old URLs (/redcastle-boarding-1/...) redirect. The boarding page is at /boarding/.

boarding_houses: Dunstan High School Hostel (99 Russell St), 5- and 7-day boarding
phone: Director of Boarding mobile 027 312 7883; hostel landline 03 448 7506; school 03 448 8595
gap_notes: A small, family-style hostel. The Matron and Director live on site and at least one other staff member is usually on duty 24/7. There is supervised prep for Years 9-11, so there is scope for a tutor. No published gap programme.
rugby_notes: A provincial co-ed school that plays in the Southern Schools competition grades. Not a traditional power.
scenery_notes: Central Otago: about 1 hr to Queenstown and Wanaka ski fields (Cardrona, Remarkables, Coronet). Otago Central Rail Trail, lakes, mountain biking.
notes: The 2027 hostel pack gives hostel@dunstan.school.nz as the Director of Boarding's contact email. Jason Barron is named on https://www.dunstan.school.nz/boarding/boarding-dunstan. The inferred email follows the first-initial+surname pattern (e.g. glochaden@dunstan.school.nz in the 2025 hostel handbook).

boarding_houses: MAC Hostel Programme (self-catering villas of six, Year 13 only)
contact_name: Hostel Manager (not named online); email goes to PA to the Principal
contact_title: PA to the Principal (hostel applications contact)
gap_notes: Small Year 13 hostel with a hostel manager and assistant manager. Students cater for themselves, so there is less need for gap tutors. A long shot, but the outdoor-pursuits focus could suit a coaching gappy.
rugby_notes: Co-ed school that plays in the Southern/Otago schools grades. Not a rugby powerhouse.
scenery_notes: Wanaka: Treble Cone and Cardrona ski fields, Lake Wanaka, Mt Aspiring National Park. The hostel runs weekend outdoor-pursuits trips.
notes: Years 7-13 school. The hostel is for Year 13 only, so it is less relevant for a Years 9-13 boarding assistant role. The staff directory is rendered by JavaScript and no hostel manager name could be extracted.

boarding_houses: Coldstream Hostel (across the road from the school)
contact_title: Director of Boarding (role created end of 2024)
gap_notes: No published gap programme. The hostel staff page lists only the Director of Boarding and a Hostel Administrator (Michelle Russell). Long-serving Manager Sue Mills retired in July 2026, so there may be staffing needs.
rugby_notes: Strongest 1st XV in the region: won the Southern Schools title four years running (2023-2026; beat King's High 49-17 in the 2026 final). Plays in the South Island Boys' Schools competition. Very strong rugby culture, a big plus for a Bath Academy captain.
scenery_notes: Invercargill is a gateway to Fiordland (Milford/Doubtful Sounds), Stewart Island, the Catlins, and Queenstown about 2.5 hrs away.
notes: No personal staff emails are published on the Wix site. ZoomInfo hints at an initial-based format but that is not verified, so no inferred email is given. Address the email to Shaun Fitzgibbon via coldstream@.
